CREATE FUNCTION make_record(n int)
  RETURNS RECORD LANGUAGE plpgsql PARALLEL SAFE AS
$$
BEGIN
  RETURN CASE n
           WHEN 1 THEN ROW(1)
           WHEN 2 THEN ROW(1, 2)
           WHEN 3 THEN ROW(1, 2, 3)
           WHEN 4 THEN ROW(1, 2, 3, 4)
           ELSE ROW(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
         END;
END;
$$
shape:

  RETURN CASE n
           WHEN 1 THEN ROW(1)
           WHEN 2 THEN ROW(1, 2)
           WHEN 3 THEN ROW(1, 2, 3)
           WHEN 4 THEN ROW(1, 2, 3, 4)
           ELSE ROW(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
         END;
END;
';
